_v1_notes.PRODUCT|TRANSPORT MODE: cannabis is N for body-carrying and postal parcels - the volume per unit value makes both pointless. Precursors are N for aircraft, couriers and parcels: they move as industrial bulk or not at all.
_v1_notes.PRODUCT|CONCEALMENT: cannabis cannot be dissolved, cannot be internally concealed at useful volume, and cannot be declared as something else - its odour and bulk defeat all three; only machinery concealment works. Precursors are N for dissolution and internal concealment, and Y for open declaration, which is their characteristic offence. Cocaine and opioids are N for open declaration.
_v1_notes.PRODUCT|ORGANISATION: precursors are N for a regional network and an independent operator - neither has an industrial supply relationship.
_v1_notes.PRODUCT|INTERDICTION POINT: synthetic opioid is N at origin production site: a laboratory has no fixed agricultural footprint to interdict. Precursors are N at destination distribution, since the offence completes before that.
_v1_notes.TRANSPORT MODE|CONCEALMENT: internal concealment is Y only for a body courier. Containers, aircraft and parcels are all N for it. Aircraft and parcels are N for open declaration; parcels are N for machinery concealment.
_v1_notes.TRANSPORT MODE|ORGANISATION: small aircraft is N for a regional network, an independent operator and an insider - none owns air assets. Container shipping is N for an independent operator. Postal is N for a cartel, which does not move tonnage by parcel.
_v1_notes.TRANSPORT MODE|INTERDICTION POINT: body courier and postal are both N at origin production site - neither passes through it.
_v1_notes.CONCEALMENT|ORGANISATION: dissolution, machinery and open declaration all require infrastructure an independent operator lacks. Internal concealment is N for a cartel and N for an insider - neither uses it as a method.
_v1_notes.ORGANISATION|INTERDICTION POINT: only a cartel is interdictable at the origin production site. An independent operator has no financial flow worth targeting. An insider has no product ownership, so origin and destination distribution are N.
